settings.label: Our Story
settings.title_prefix: We didn't start in a lab.
settings.subtitle: Walk into any pharmacy in Pakistan and you'll find hundreds of products. But how many were made for our UV index? Our humidity? Our skin tones?

settings.label: The Beginning
settings.title:
A Market That Was Full.
And Completely Empty.
settings.body_1: Walk into any pharmacy in Lahore or Karachi. You'll see global brands priced for global incomes — and local products that hide behind vague "nourishing blend" labels, telling you nothing about what's actually inside. Neither felt right.
settings.pullquote: "Pakistani skin faces challenges that European and American formulations were never designed for. Extreme UV, hard water, monsoon humidity, and Fitzpatrick IV–VI tones that mark differently. We decided to stop adapting products that were never made for us — and start from the skin up."
settings.body_2: The ingredients we needed existed. The clinical research was there. What didn't exist was a brand that combined transparent formulation with honest pricing — for the skin that actually lives here. Glowve was that gap.

settings.label: Behind the Brand
settings.quote: "We spent years looking for skincare that respected our climate, our skin tones, and our intelligence. We couldn't find it. So we built it."
settings.bio: Glowve was built by people who grew up navigating pharmacies full of products that weren't made for them. After years watching brands translate Western formulations for Pakistani shelves without changing a single ingredient, the team decided the approach itself needed to change. It began with one question: what does Pakistani skin actually need?
settings.note: The focus is the work, not the faces behind it.

settings.label: The Glowve Insight
settings.title:
Pakistan didn't need its 201st product.
It needed three that actually
worked together.
settings.subtitle: We stopped the noise. We focused on skin biology in our specific environmental context — and built backwards from there.

settings.headline: The UV Mismatch
settings.body: Most sunscreens are tested for European UV indices (average 4). In Pakistan, we regularly hit 10–12. We built our SPF for the plateau, not the valley. Six-filter broad spectrum, tested locally.

settings.headline: The PIH Problem
settings.body: Fitzpatrick IV–VI skin marks differently. A breakout doesn't just fade — it leaves post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation that lasts months. We target the pigment-inflammation loop directly.

settings.headline: The Barrier Paradox
settings.body: Humidity can fool you into thinking your barrier is healthy. In hard water climates, it's often the opposite — stripped and sensitised. A lightweight, ceramide-led moisturiser fixes what the environment breaks.

settings.headline: The Label Problem
settings.body: Ingredient transparency isn't the norm in Pakistani skincare. "Brightening blend" tells you nothing. We list every ingredient, explain what it does, and tell you the concentration. Always.
